criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Six frames pass the bold test or come close; frame 2 the showstopper with counts 126, 108, 81 matching. Frame 5 a flat mid-grey slab with stair-stepped cast and banded dead bottom. Frame 8 wheel half a frame right of the figure, hand on the cushion, no windshield or road, grey door panel. Frame 6 floating block skyline with a sphere, blue-grey cars, empty bottom. Matte clay paint; frame 2's outer blocks cropped by the edges.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One deck: the lot recurs, the stripe carries one meaning, key and dark field hold, three devices working, value cut honest. 5 and 8 sit outside the dark register; 6's paint breaks the limestone.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every figure re-derived and every numeral traces; primary sources; every rejected finding honoured. Looser phrasings: slide 8's its Permian Basin trucks vs c68's customer-owned trucks; slide 1 and caption juxtapose the requirement with the count; the Dallas exchange undated though from the September 18th, 2025 adoption.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Who is on the list, the cost and term, Dallas refused, where enforcement starts, where to send a concern. SB 2807 and the Legislature unnamed on slides; no deadline; the Dallas exchange undated.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, turn at 5 lands. 3 and 4 both end on ITE at 7; 7 and 9 restate the injury standard.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register with some well-turned lines; report-speak lists on nearly every slide; no regional texture beyond kickers.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fourth AV deck in 30 days (52, 59, 67); white sensor-topped stand-ins on a dark lot again; shares companies and the Dallas to Laredo lane; lastLight; opens on a count.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild frame 8 with hands on the rim and the road visible, rebuild frame 5 as a lit rule on a near-black mat, and change slide 8's its Permian Basin trucks to customer-owned trucks.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Wheel half a frame right of the figure, hand on the cushion, no windshield or road, grey door panel.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Passenger-seat camera at 1.9 m looking forward-left, wheel in front of the figure, hands on the rim, windshield open to road and seam.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat mid-grey slab, stair-stepped cast, banded dead bottom.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Low raking oblique so the rule fills the lower two thirds, key on the stop face and groove walls only, higher shadow resolution.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Floating block skyline with a sphere, blue-grey cars, empty bottom third.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Sink the skyline into the haze, delete the sphere, limestone paint, lower the camera to the tail rows.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: ITE leader a stub on its own 7; other leaders end on dim cars.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Run each leader to its company's divider and light the far single car.
